title: Adobe security advisory (AV26-1092)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1092 Date: October 28, 2026 As of October 27, 2026, Adobe is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Adobe Substance 3D Painter Prior to or equal to 12.1.5 Creative Cloud Desktop Application Prior to or equal to 6.10 Adobe Campaign Classic Prior to or equal to 7.4.4 build 9402 Adobe Connect Android Mobile App Prior to or equal to 4.4 Adobe Connect Desktop App Prior to or equal to 2026.8.51 (Win), 2026.08.45 (Mac Silicon), 2026.01.39 (Mac Intel) The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Security updates available for Substance 3D Painter | APSB26-178 Security update available for Adobe Creative Cloud Desktop Application | APSB26-135 Security update available for Adobe Campaign Classic | APSB26-162 Security update available for Adobe Connect | APSB26-182 Adobe Security Bulletins and Advisories Article Link: Adobe security advisory (AV26-1092) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
